apps.localizedDescription:
Madeira runs unmodified Windows PC games on an iPhone inside a single iOS app.

• FEX-Emu translates x86/x86-64 to ARM64
• Wine 11.4 (ARM64EC, WoW64 for 32-bit games)
• DXMT for Direct3D 9/10/11 on Metal
• madeira-d3d12 for Direct3D 12 on Metal

Features: game library, Steam sign-in and installs via Madeira Dock, Steam Cloud saves, Bluetooth controllers and touch controls, keyboard/mouse passthrough, Japanese locale per game.

Requires JIT (StikDebug or the built-in StikJIT helper). iOS 26+ recommended. Active research project — expect rough edges.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 (original bundle ID, build 173)**

A nightly build for testers. It uses the original bundle ID `com.willfaust.madeora`. The complete source of this exact build is attached (`Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 og source.zip`): the Madeira tree as it was built, with the wine, FEX, DXMT and Dock folders and Madeira's own FEX and Dock patches already applied.

This build contains code ported from MetalSharp (AGPL-3.0), written by BOR1NG (Avery Felts, https://github.com/aaf2tbz): the Overwatch 2 fixes, section views, debug registers, XSAVE state revert and the opt-in Intel flag behaviour. It also contains code from MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1) and MetalSharp's FEX patches (MIT), and from Mullion (LGPL-2.1-or-later, https://github.com/dttdrv/mullion). Thank you. Details are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and SOURCE-INFO.txt. Madeira's own code stays GPL-3.0-or-later.

Not included in the source: private keys and tokens, and the build machine's scripts.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.72**
Everything big since 0.2.32

**Where we were at 0.2.32**
- Built on the older Wine (11.4) and older FEX and DXMT
- Batch uninstall, Move Games, Reset All / Verify All, session menu tabs, mouse lock, auto controller setup, BepInEx mods and Get Game Parts had just landed
- Overwatch 2 didn't get in game
- LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga drew a black world

**Tested and working on our phones**
- **Wine 11.22:** a big under-the-hood update, plus newer FEX and DXMT
- **DirectX 12 games** start and show a picture again
- **Resident Evil Village:** plays full screen, and the intro and prologue videos play (use Wi-Fi, see below)
- **Slay the Spire 2:** black screen fixed
- **Deep Rock Galactic (DX11):** runs great, over 100 FPS in places
- **LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga:** the world draws again
- **Battle.net** launcher opens again
- **Steam** no longer hangs for minutes when it can't connect
- **DirectX badge** shows which DirectX the game really used
- **Console look:** Settings → Appearance → Console look
- **Fewer crashes** in games that start lots of threads

**New, not tested yet (tell us how it goes)**
- **Fallout: New Vegas:** launcher window shows again
- **Satisfactory:** crash at start and the Visual C++ (x64) box fixed
- **Slay the Spire 2:** smoother, built-in setting

- **Controllers:** more fixes in games
